subsetPolicyRationale: `s.stdio.mp3@mpeg1-layer3` is this plugin's own self-contained MPEG-1 Layer III audio file — there is no alternate conformance profile, encoding variant or standard subclass to split against: every mutation (set-snapshot, set-id3v2, set-frames, set-id3v1, …) reads and writes the SAME single value model this plugin owns, through the SAME codec/dispatch regardless of which field or entity it touches. `✳️any` remains this artifact's only real scope.
